label: G4_wrap_none_short
kill_reason: Stopped by hand (SIGTERM, returncode -15) after 8253 s of CPU for 250 events -- 33 s/event, against 0.65 s/event for the same crystal with a Teflon wrap. The unwrapped polished crystal is computationally pathological: total internal reflection at a bare polished air interface is lossless, and a skew ray in a cylinder preserves its angle to the wall, so photons survive an enormous number of steps. Two cores at 100 % were overheating the machine. No result recorded.
